name: ShockRings
notes: Pool of 16, one instanced annulus strip (96 segments = 192 tris per ring; 3072 max). Premultiplied blend (additive emission + partial occlusion so hue survives white cloud). Bounds shown for the board ring (maxRadius 29 m, aspect 1.75). Band layout follows REF_VERIFICATION (red inner / green / blue outer, ~13% of radius). intensity() gives a 0..1 envelope to drive PostFrame.chroma toward post.chroma.ring.
